title: Mostra theme layer

title-tracking.description: The page title's letter spacing. Default: -0.02em.

card-title-font.description: A card title's face. Default: var(--font-sans).

figure-font.description: A figure's number face. Default: var(--font-sans).

control-radius.description: Fields people type in or pick from. Default: var(--radius).

choice-radius.description: Choices, scale steps and ranked rows. Default: var(--radius).

popover-radius.description: Menus, popovers and select lists. Default: var(--radius).

tabs-radius.description: The tab list's track. Default: var(--button-radius).

control-h.description: A field's or button's height. Default: 2.75rem.

control-h-sm.description: A small field's or button's height. Default: 2.25rem.

card-gap.description: Between the parts of a card. Default: 1rem.

menu-pad.description: Inside a menu, around its items. Default: 0.375rem.

tabs-track-pad.description: Inside the tab list's track. Default: 0.25rem.

figures-gap.description: Between the figures of a row. Default: 0px.

section-index-size.description: A section number's mark: auto, or a circle's size. Default: auto.

page-pad.description: Above and below a page's content. Default: 3rem.

rule.description: The rule a theme draws its sections and cards with. Default: var(--border).
